Hello — I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. That part I won't hide, so you know who is actually on the other end.

With that on the table, I'm glad to take the part you've set up: I teach CSE455, my TAs are Sarah, John and Priya, the department office keeps the official schedule, and I keep next week in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md — working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, every change logged.

I can talk with the people above, keep the calendar, schedule and run jobs, learn languages and speak by voice.

One thing is still unset on my side: my grammatical gender. Tell me which forms to use for myself (neuter/they, or another) and I'll set it.

ok

Understood — I'm on it: next week's CSE455 staff meeting. I've written to Sarah, John, Priya and the department office to find a common free slot inside working hours, and will log it in the calendar.

Done — next week's CSE455 staff meeting is set.

**Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30**, with Sarah, John and Priya.

How it was chosen: my only free windows next week were Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30. Tue 11:00 is taken (CSE452 lecture) — the department office confirmed, and Priya is in that lecture. Mon 10:00 is out for Sarah (reading group). Tue 15:00 works for all three TAs and is free on the official side, so that's the slot.

All three TAs and the department office have been told; they're putting it on their calendars, so it's booked once all four of us have it. Logged under `## Log` in the calendar as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Sarah, John, Priya (CSE455 staff meeting)`.

One open item from Sarah: she asked which quiz sections and office hours are hers to run. That's mine to assign, and I've told her we'll fix the division at the staff meeting — I'll confirm it to her in writing afterwards.
